## v0.1.15

- Add authenticated movie and series search through the configured request automation services. Selecting a result creates a pending request; content is submitted only after an administrator approves it.
- Let administrators create test requests from the same neutral request form while keeping the complete request queue visible above it.
- Select root folders and quality/language profiles from Radarr and Sonarr during approval, so only service URLs and API keys need configuration.
- Remove active TMDb/TVDB request integrations and automatically clean obsolete metadata credentials and Arr root/profile selections from existing settings files.
- Request Emby's creation-date ordering for library synchronization so latest-content views match Emby more closely.
